name: Overlay
description: Shows a data source's image in a zone of the screen, over the background, until the next run replaces it or the data source has nothing to show.

properties.name: dataSource
properties.title: Data Source
properties.description: What to show: a data source made for overlays.

properties.name: zone
properties.title: Zone
properties.description: Where on the screen: one of six boxes, three across the top and three across the bottom.

properties.name: wash
properties.title: Wash
properties.description: A halo around the text so it reads over a busy picture: 0 is none, 1 is the strongest.

properties.name: washColor
properties.title: Wash Color
properties.description: auto: white or black, whichever has the better WCAG contrast with the text's colors (the worst-off color counts).

properties.name: washStyle
properties.title: Wash Style
properties.description: soft: a blurred halo. solid: a hard-edged outline with no gradient, which a color e-ink panel draws more cleanly (it turns a gradient into dots); use a wash of 1 with it.
